intent: Eight individual material-quality tasks distinguish weight, strength, weakness, material state, texture, speed effects and filled contents with precise timing and scope.
picturePurpose: Original full/empty towel baskets establish visible contents and fullness only. Cleanliness is given by the source text. A coded event-order task preserves firing before hardening without inventing temperature or duration.

transfer.stem: Which report matches the notes about the clay, wood and towels?
transfer.passage:
Notes from our craft-club visit
For the walk to the craft centre, we chose light bags. The teacher meant bags that did not weigh much, not bags with lights inside them. Beside the canal, a worker said that strong rope was needed to secure a boat. This described the rope and its purpose; it did not say that the boat had already been secured. A sign described one weak support on an old bridge, without reporting that every support had collapsed.
At the centre, we saw a clay model that had become hard after firing. The teacher then asked us to sand a wooden frame until it felt smooth. We had to check the surface rather than stop after an invented number of minutes. A soft towel was ready for wrapping a glass. A basket beside the table was full of clean towels; the note explicitly described them as clean.
On our return, a rough path slowed a bicycle down. It still moved, so the slower speed did not mean it was permanently broken.

options.text: The clay became hard after firing; sanding continues until the wood feels smooth; the basket contains clean towels and is full.
The clay became hard before firing; sanding continues until the wood feels smooth; the basket contains clean towels and is full.
The clay became hard after firing; sanding stops while the wood is still rough; the basket contains clean towels and is full.
The clay became hard after firing; sanding continues until the wood feels smooth; the basket is empty and contains no towels.

answer.display: The clay became hard after firing; sanding continues until the wood feels smooth; the basket contains clean towels and is full.
